title: Beatrix and the Alibi
author: Dominic Nystrom
blurb: Vesper Vasquez, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
